scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix portal && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,bemor,portal -c yellow,green,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:portal"
scripts.demo:reset: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('backend/.demo-data',{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('Demo ma\u2019lumotlar o\u2018chirildi. Backend qayta ishga tushganda yangidan yaratiladi.')"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix portal run build && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.test: node --test frontend/tests/auth-flow.test.mjs frontend/tests/auth-redirect.test.mjs frontend/tests/uploads-and-maps.test.mjs && npm --prefix backend test
